name: Tepora
tagline: Every furnace, heat pump, and mini-split you own — remembered and cared for.
positioning: Tepora is the home-comfort logbook for hands-on homeowners and solo HVAC pros who service their own systems and want nothing to fall through the cracks.

hero.h1: Keep every system in your home running like it's brand new.
hero.sub: Tepora tracks each furnace, heat pump, and mini-split you maintain — logging filters, refrigerant, and tune-ups so you always know exactly what's due and when.

features.title: One profile per system
features.description: Give every furnace, condenser, and mini-split its own record — model, serial, install date, and filter size — so you're never guessing in the crawlspace again.

features.title: Maintenance that actually reminds you
features.description: Filter swaps, coil cleanings, and seasonal tune-ups show up on a timeline with reminders before they're overdue, not three months after.

features.title: A service log you'll trust
features.description: Snap a photo, note the pressures, jot the part number. Every visit is timestamped and searchable, so warranty claims take minutes instead of an afternoon.

features.title: Seasonal tune-up checklists
features.description: Guided spring and fall walkthroughs built for real equipment — capacitor checks, condensate lines, static pressure — with nothing skipped.

features.title: Part numbers on hand
features.description: Save the exact filter, igniter, and capacitor for each unit so reordering is one tap, not a parking-lot phone call to the supply house.

features.title: Costs you can see
features.description: Log what each repair and part cost and watch the running total per system — the number that tells you when to fix versus replace.

testimonials.quote: I service the HVAC at four rental units. Tepora is the first thing that kept the filter sizes and furnace serials straight without a shoebox of receipts.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: As a solo tech, my system logs used to live in my head. Now every visit is photographed and dated, and my warranty claims stopped bouncing back.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: We heat with a boiler and cool with two mini-splits. Tepora finally put all three on one maintenance calendar my husband and I both check.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For the homeowner keeping one or two systems on track.
For prosumers running comfort across a whole property.
For independent techs servicing their own client list.

homepage.footerBlurb: Tepora keeps the heating and cooling in your home honest — one logbook for every system you look after.
